title: Thieves
body: Despite the fact that they keep removing my review they’ve still stolen my money and refuses to refund me. BEWARE!!!

title: Flights don’t show
body: I try to schedule my flights early but they don't show until a few weeks before. Otherwise its a good app.

title: Calendar Sync
body: Flighty has a feature that detects when flights are deleted from the calendar and also deletes it from the app which helps crew members from having to constantly delete flights from the app as their schedule changes.

title: Great UI and accurate info
body: Really like everything about this app, the relevant information for flights, the ability to track friend’s flights and the history it keeps for my flights. As a future improvement, it would be nice to be able to see seat maps, which would also help in selecting better seats. Great job!

title: Fantastic app
body: I absolutely love this app. From how user friendly it is, to the way it looks, to the flight updates, and stat keeping. It’s incredible.

title: Best app for flying!
body: I love this app, so much, I only just got it and it is amazing. But, just a feature request, could you add a feature where you can see if it has wifi, the wifi name, and maybe other stuff?

title: Love it - App in the Air Alternative
body: Love using this app. I used to be a user of App in the Air up until it shut down and I had struggled trying to find a similar alternative to it. I came across byAir and it is so similar to App in the Air but a little bit cooler.

title: Great For Travelers And Crew
body: I love byAir. As a training pilot, it’s so nice to have a redundancy for my log, and it’s super nice to have stats available for those. I wish the lifetime subscription didn’t increase in price so drastically recently, but that is my only gripe. Another feature I’d love to see is the flight map on the “upcoming flights” section like on Flightly, but even without it, I’m a happy camper

title: Great App
body: Would be better if there was less of a pay wall. Otherwise great app!

title: App In The Air is back
body: God I remember using App in The Air for every trip then it got removed. This has been a game changer in the way that it provides that same detail and same friendly interface. Thank you devs!

title: Bye flighty
body: I have seen the app on Thread by a comment and straight fall in love with the features, I bought the one-time payment and transferred all my flights history to byAir.

title: Супер
body: Приложение крутое, правда, четко все показывает, еще и без рекламы, много очень инфы есть. По возможности хотелось бы только, чтобы еще показывались стойки регистрации - было бы вообще супермега круто! ❤️

title: Nice app
body: The app looks great, I really like the design. The support team is very helpful and quick to reply. I recommend it!

title: Thank you for your support.
body: Thank you so much for your support. I will ask you if I have any questions if I need help.

title: Does not calendar sync
body: This app does not sync with your calendar.

title: Great app for the frequent flyers
body: Great app for frequent flyers. It's possible to see all the flight details, get the alerts in time and see the information about the airports. It would be great to add the option to merge flights into the trips in the future! Wish the app all the best!
